story.hook: My roommate charged me every time I sat down.
story.script: He taped a handwritten price list beside the television and announced that sitting on the couch after dinner now cost five dollars, plus another two dollars if I used a cushion, because he said I was wearing out the furniture faster than him. I stared at the list for a full minute before asking whether he remembered who had actually bought the couch. He confidently told me it belonged to the apartment, so I opened my old receipt and showed him my name, the delivery address, and the purchase date from months before he moved in. Then I asked whether he wanted to keep charging me to use my own furniture or start paying me rent for using it himself. The price list disappeared immediately.

youtube.title: My Roommate Charged Me to Sit Down #Shorts
youtube.description: A ridiculous couch fee immediately backfires. An original Wacky Dramas story.
